newsitem.title: NEW ZEALAND: Radio Pacific-Energy Pacific deal unconditional.
newsitem.headline: Radio Pacific-Energy Pacific deal unconditional.

text.p: Radio Pacific Ltd's offer to buy all the shares in North Island radio company Energy Enterprises was declared unconditional on Wedesday.

All shareholders of Energy Enterprises accepted the offer with holders of 1,632,118 energy shares, 84 percent, chosing to accept six new Radio Pacific shares for every five Energy Enterprises shares, Radio Pacific said.
Pacific will issue the new shares at $3.05 per share.
The remaining Energy Enterprises shareholders accepted Pacific's cash offer of $3.60 per share.
Radio Pacific shareholders approved the takeover at a special meeting of shareholders on March 6.

"The cash that the larger company should generate, coupled with a prudent and management debt policy, should put us in a good position to take advantage of further opportunities as they arise, or as we create them" chairman Derek Lowe said.
"Although radio will remain an extremely competitive performance based industry in the foreseeable future, there is definitely scope for us to grow the company further" he said.
Radio Pacific's shares last traded at $3.45 on March 31.
